title: One napkin. Part 6 (finale)
note: Silent finale, standalone. Opener 0-3.2 s is the ONLY part that differs by hook: sidewalk outside the night diner, neon OPEN->CLOSED, 12:00 AM, her brother's car headlights at the kerb, both phones lit mid-swipe in frame 1, the last napkin 'your turn.' in his hand; phones pocketed ~1 s (b: she catches his lit screen, '!', his flinch). Take 1 (B, viewers' loser): I'LL SAVE / YOU A SLICE., she smiles politely and gets in the car, it drives off; next day the pie case is empty SOLD OUT; no name no number no pie, he slumps. Slice wipe counter-clockwise 'rewind. take 2.'. Take 2 (A, viewers' pick): WES. / YOURS?, she writes rosa. and 'same stool / next year?', honk, she taps the car window and waves, he holds the napkin up to the neon and smiles, the waitress flips the neon back to OPEN and deadpans a thumbs-up. End card 32.6-36 with the soft link-in-bio line (on from 33.1). No vote.

strips.text: the girl I like is leaving and I don't know her name.
she caught me swiping. now her ride is here.
we shared one slice of pie tonight.
she's leaving. I never got her name.
she smiles politely. then she's gone.
the next day. the case is empty.
no name. no number. no pie.
she taps the glass. she waves.
